title: Policy that reads its own table: infinite recursion (SQLSTATE 42P17)
issue: A policy on memberships that subselects memberships (the natural way to say 'members can see their org's members') re-expands the same policy and Postgres raises 'infinite recursion detected in policy'. Cross-table cycles do the same.
symptom: naive_rls returns an error for every query touching memberships (and docs, whose policy reads memberships). The other variants must return the baseline's rows.

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.docs (10 orgs, 100 users; each user belongs to 2 orgs)

subjects.name: user1
subjects.note: member of 2 orgs; may see all members of those orgs and their docs
